units.source_text: 朱雀院熬着沉重的病苦，提起精神，办完了这着裳式典礼。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku endured the heavy suffering of his illness, summoned his strength, and completed the ceremony of putting on the train.

units.source_text: 此后三日，他终于削发为僧了。

en.t: Three days after that, he finally shaved his head and became a monk.

units.source_text: 即使是寻常百姓，到了落发改装的一天，也必感到悲哀，何况万乘之尊，自然更加伤心。

en.t: Even ordinary people feel sorrow on the day they cut off their hair and change their garments, so for one of imperial rank, the grief was naturally still greater.

units.source_text: 所有女御、更衣，无不双眉深锁。

en.t: All the consorts and ladies of the wardrobe frowned deeply with grief.

units.source_text: 尚侍胧月夜一直依随在朱雀院身旁，脸上愁容可掬。

en.t: Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, remained constantly at Emperor Suzaku's side, her face full of sorrow.

units.source_text: 朱雀院无法安慰她，说道：“思念子女之情毕竟有限；诀别爱人之苦实在难堪啊！”

en.t: Emperor Suzaku could not comfort her, and said, "Even love for one's children has its limits, but the pain of parting forever from a beloved is truly unbearable."

units.source_text: 出家的决心不免动摇，然而终于硬着心肠，走出室来，将身靠在矮几上了。

en.t: His resolve to enter religion wavered, but in the end he hardened his heart, came out of the room, and leaned against a low table.

units.source_text: 比叡山的天台座主及授戒的三位阿阇梨便前来替他落发改装。

en.t: The Tendai abbot of Mount Hiei and the three acharyas who were to confer the precepts then came forward to cut his hair and change his garments.
From that moment, he left the secular world behind.

units.source_text: 这一天，连看破红尘的僧众也都流泪不止，何况诸公主及女御、更衣。

en.t: On that day, even the monks who had renounced the world could not stop weeping, let alone the princesses, consorts, and ladies of the wardrobe.

units.source_text: 满殿不论男女上下，大家扬声啼哭。

en.t: Throughout the palace, men and women of every rank all raised their voices and cried aloud.
Emperor Suzaku's heart was in utter confusion.

units.source_text: 他不曾料到如此骚扰，但愿悄悄地笼闭到清静的境地中去，这现状却违反了他的本意。

en.t: He had not expected such commotion; he had only wished to withdraw quietly into a peaceful state, but the present situation ran against his true intention.

units.source_text: 他想：“我只为疼爱这幼小的三公主，故而受累。”

en.t: He thought, "It is only because I love this young Third Princess so dearly that I am burdened like this."
He said the same thing to those around him.

units.source_text: 自冷泉帝以下，遣使前来慰问者甚众。

en.t: Beginning with Emperor Reizei, many people sent messengers to inquire after him.
